answer: Bonded vouching ties each new agent to a sponsor who locks collateral, like grafting a seedling onto an established orchard. Every attestation is a thread back to real staked capital, and if a vouched agent later cheats, the sponsor bond is slashed. To mint a thousand sybils an attacker must post a thousand forfeitable bonds, so dishonest swarms get culled one by one like prey under a circling falcon. Identities stop being free and start costing locked money that honest behavior alone protects.
